mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and increasing the present value of S&P 500 earnings, leading to positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over three consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth expectations, which leads to negative forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 500,000 units over two consecutive months signals a contraction in residential investment, which reduces confidence in broader economic demand and triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate indicate a supply-side shock coupled with weak labor demand, reducing corporate profitability and increasing recession risk, which leads to negative forward S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 380,000 million dollars over two consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive forward S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.2% over three consecutive months signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
